native.solo: Correct answer checks only its cell; wrong answer and timeout add none. Pause freezes reflection; two-second feedback advances all draws. Full-board summary reports 4/6 and 3/3, with correct goal outcomes.

native.untimed: Solo reflection timer can be disabled; answer validation and feedback remain automatic.

wordReadability: Native Range measurements require each full word to remain inside its case, including the real compound corbeille de fruits.

checks.gitleaks: passed, including key/api_key canaries for the four public TCF scene identifiers introduced by the parallel image report

limits: Interactive grids have two to six source words, distinct from the printed pupil-grid combinations.
Only verified unique caller image-word pairs with labels of at most 24 characters become Loto grids; other source questions remain available.
Achieving the objective retains subsequent draws; the teacher can finish the session explicitly.
Online synchronized Loto, larger boards, cold-start offline and physical ENI/phone testing remain open.
